name: Magical Princess Monica
original_name: まじかるプリンセス　モニカ
source:
Sota is a young man who dreams about marrying a princess.
One day, his dream comes true. 2 princesses from another world appears before him.
Monica and her sister Alto ask Sota to give them a help. And it turns out to be a naughty one.

[description from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE055254.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
颯太是一名梦想迎娶公主的年轻人。
一天，他的梦想成真了。两位来自异世界的公主出现在他面前。
莫妮卡与姐姐阿尔托请求颯太提供帮助，而她们需要的竟是一种色情的帮助。
